title: One suite of T-495's claimable half: agent-hidden-drawer rewritten from a source-text scanner into a behavioural suite, and wired
scope: One suite, because T-495's acceptance is per suite. It is suite 6 of the 11 in the claimable half; 5 remain, all in src/__tests__/integration/agents: agent-inline-recommendation, agent-mission-panel, agent-mission-surface-wiring, ask-anything-bar, mission-workflow-handoff.
The gated half of T-495 -- the rows carrying textIsTheSubject -- is NOT touched here.

This record exists so the T-770 control resolves this path's classification from the LATEST record rather than from the T-492 draw, which is left as the historical draw it is. Measured: with the workflow step added and this record absent, t770-scanner-wiring-refusal fails 2 of 7 and names this suite.
method: Re-verified on origin/main d918410c10 by running the suite, not by reading it: 51 passed of 51. Fifteen of the 51 read a repository file as text: nine read src/components/agents/AgentHiddenDrawer.tsx and grepped it for attribute spellings, import specifiers, 'use client', useState/useEffect and the collapsed-drawer copy; six read src/lib/agent/agent-hidden-drawer-view.ts, stripped strings and comments, and grepped for Date.now, Math.random, new Date and fetch, or grepped the raw text for two import specifiers.

The fifteen text cases were DELETED rather than repaired. The 36 cases over buildAgentHiddenDrawerView and its helpers were already behaviour -- they call the builder and assert its return value -- and are kept byte-for-byte, as the T-492 verdict for this file asked.

Thirteen cases replace them. Eight RENDER AgentHiddenDrawer with react-dom/server: the root <section> carries the act3 marker, data-drawer-state and the aria-label; no aria-expanded is rendered; the trigger label, the highest-priority badge, the honest disclaimer, the portfolio line and the collapsed-drawer copy all render from the view; exactly one AgentBadge renders per ACTIVE agent in canonical order; a supplied view prop is rendered instead of the seed; an empty view renders no priority badge and no agent badge. One calls the component as a plain function with no React dispatcher -- a hook would throw 'Invalid hook call' there -- which is what 'server component, no hooks' means. Two build the view under two different fake clocks and two different Math.random values and require byte-identical output, and install a throwing fetch that must never be called. Two assert derivation: panelView equals the AG11 hidden_drawer seed, and portfolioContext equals the ACT2 inventory's total, pilot+production+scaled and discovery counts.

Non-vacuity measured, not assumed: the seed has steward inactive (2+2+2+3 missions; nexus, sentinel, atlas active), so the per-active-agent badge case can tell 'active only' from 'every agent', and the case asserts that precondition itself.

Dropped without replacement, with the reason: 'imports from abarva-theme' and 'imports AgentBadge from @/components/abarva/AgentBadge' asserted import specifiers. The badge half is replaced by the rendered data-agent check (AgentBadge is what emits data-agent); the theme-token import is a styling choice with no behaviour to assert.

Ten mutations -- six against AgentHiddenDrawer.tsx and four against agent-hidden-drawer-view.ts -- each verified by git diff --numstat to have changed the file before either suite ran, and each run against the new suite and against the deleted scanner restored from origin/main.

suites.rationale: The fifteen deleted cases asserted what two files say. Measured against ten mutations that change what the component renders or what the builder returns, the deleted scanner caught two -- data-drawer-state removed, and the panel built from the wrong variant (the latter through a kept builder case, not a scanner case) -- and missed eight, including a plain Date.now() field added to the view, which its own 'does not call Date.now' case should have caught and did not because its single-quote stripping regex, /'[^']*'/g, matches across newlines and removed the code lying between two quote characters on different lines (traced step by step: the call survives the template and double-quote passes and is gone after the single-quote pass). The new suite caught all ten.
